title: [Feature Request]: Disable automatic context auto-compaction and unlock full 1M context window

labels.name: comp:conversations
labels.description: Managing Conversations, Workspace Scoping, Resuming sessions, Branching

body:
### Is your feature request related to a specific problem?

The Antigravity CLI (`agy`) enforces a rigid, backend-level auto-compaction around ~140k-150k tokens. 

This behavior cannot be disabled or adjusted via `settings.json`, environment variables, or CLI flags.

When auto-compaction triggers, it performs an aggressive, lossy summarization of the session history. This causes immediate "amnesia": the agent loses track of architectural constraints, previously read files, and active variables, frequently entering infinite re-read loops. For non-trivial engineering tasks requiring multi-turn context, this hard limit makes the CLI completely unviable.

### Describe the solution you'd like

1. Allow developers to utilize at least 70% (or more) of the model's native context window (e.g., 700k+ tokens on Gemini 1M models) without triggering automatic compaction.
2. Provide an explicit setting or CLI flag (e.g., `--disable-auto-compact` or `AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE` in `settings.json`) to let users decide if/when they want compaction.
3. If compaction must occur, make it an explicit manual command (like `/compact`) rather than an unprompted background action.

### Describe alternatives you've considered

- Manually fragmenting tasks into multiple isolated markdown plan files and restarting fresh CLI sessions every few turns. This creates severe operational friction.
- Relying on competitor tools: Continuing to use Claude Code and Codex, where larger contexts are fully unlocked and usable.

### Additional context

I am a power user actively working with Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode. Recently, OpenAI responded to developer demand and enabled usable 272k+ context windows on Codex, which justified subscribing to their Pro plan.

Antigravity has excellent models with 1M+ token capacity, but the premature auto-compaction at 150k prevents serious adoption by developers handling large codebases. Unlocking the context window (or allowing at least 70%+ usage without auto-compact) is essential for power users to migrate and use AGY CLI effectively in production.
